title: Teal – A statically-typed dialect of Lua
summary: Teal is a statically-typed programming language that compiles to Lua, bringing compile-time type checking and type annotations to Lua development while maintaining full compatibility with standard Lua code and runtime.
problem_solved: Adds compile-time type checking to dynamically-typed Lua, catching type-related bugs before runtime without sacrificing Lua's simplicity and performance.
why_valuable: Enables Lua developers to write safer, more maintainable code with IDE support for autocompletion and error detection while remaining fully interoperable with existing Lua ecosystems.
